description: RI TY2026: $82,421 of taxable income is 4.75% x 82,421 - 820.50 = 3,094.4975 -> $3,094 on the exact schedule. The published 'Pay' anchor $3,076.88 is a display rounding of 3,076.875; applying it plus 4.75% x 371 gives 3,094.5025 -> $3,095, a $1 overstatement that recurs at 1,589 of the 400,001 whole-dollar incomes to $400,000. The Division's worksheet constants are exact (TY2025 proves it), so the exact schedule is encoded.
